name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_020_clean_closed_dual_clair_viewer_smoke_assault
description: Separate R020 dual-clairvoyance viewer smoke-only cannibal raid arm from byte-exact clean closed-window setup.

steps.label: load_clean_closed_window_pre_signal_checkpoint
steps.expected_visible_fact: Load only the disposable profile whose 45 TestSetup00 save files match build_logs/first-smoke-011/ordinary-closed-smoke-start-manifest.json. Verify effective userdir, same-run World/current turn, Safe mode Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no pending input, unlit brazier and no prior site knowledge/signal/outing; saved baseline turn 5216234.

steps.label: no_fixture_transforms
steps.expected_visible_fact: No additional fixture transform is declared; camp geometry is the already-recorded controlled setup in the byte-exact manifest.

steps.label: dual_clair_viewer_closed_fire_smoke_to_cannibal_assault
steps.objective: From an exact clean pre-signal, closed-window prepared save, through the native debug menu grant both DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE_PLUS and DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE before fire, verify their exact IDs, advance one actual native turn and verify the viewing effect. Then use ordinary lighter ignition of the prepared indoor brazier; keep both mutations but make no mutation changes during the run. Confirm true smoke, track same-ID scouting/watch/return/report and any actual night raid/combat, including current_exposure gate and sourced attacks. This is a viewing-aid arm and cannot substitute for ordinary-view proof.
proof_targets: exact disposable 45-file start manifest/effective userdir and same-run World/turn
clean unlit closed-window start, safe mode Off, no prior signal/contact/knowledge/outing
both exact native mutation IDs installed before fire; one real turn afterward and verified visible effect; no cloak/invulnerability
ordinary lighter ignition of indoor brazier and physical smoke; smoke-channel admission before light or contact
same-ID camp actors through physical watch/return/report and any actual night assault
exact exposure-gate facts, NPC target/action/position/health/damage source and saved actor states
native quicksave turns/payloads and simulation timing at material changes
exact process identities and supported cleanup
invariants: Both debug mutations are viewing aids only, are present before fire, and are recorded by exact IDs
No debug fire/light/smoke/contact/report/dispatch, hostile teleport, cloak, invulnerability or debug raider kill
Do not credit the viewer arm as ordinary-view evidence; keep it separate
Controlled camp geometry is setup only, not natural generation or knowledge
Track all relevant actors through native metadata/saved roster, regardless of sight; phase labels alone do not establish attack
Use current native controls; safe mode Off; preserve fire while observing

evidence_contract.claim: A clean closed-window indoor fire supplies smoke while the separately labeled dual-clairvoyance viewer setup shows its exact visible effect and the same-ID native camp response; mutations do not supply the signal.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Credit only this run’s exact mutation records, physical smoke channel, camp discovery/actor movement, gate and source-attributed combat records. Viewer evidence remains separate from ordinary view.
